text:
Type: cube storage pouffe
Use: extra seating, resting feet, hiding small things inside; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: smooth white woven fabric cover, padded lift-off lid, small black plastic feet
Colors: off-white, black feet
Shape: square box with a padded overhanging lid, straight sides, tiny feet, crisp edges, compact and solid
Feel: clean, practical, simple, calm
Goes with: white or light wood furniture, grey textiles, any accent color; minimalist or Scandinavian living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: BOSNS
product.description: The cover is easy to keep clean as it is removable and can be machine washed.
